learning_outcomes: Identify rational and irrational numbers among real numbers given in daily situations
Explain how real numbers are classified and ordered on a number line
Appreciate the importance of real numbers in measuring and trading in the community
learning_experiences: Learners work in groups to sort number cards into rational and irrational real numbers and place them on a number line drawn on the floor
Learners discuss in pairs where real numbers are used at the market, such as prices and measurements, and record examples
Learners individually write five real numbers from their home context and state whether each is rational
key_inquiry_questions: How do we know whether a real number is rational or irrational?
Why are real numbers useful when we measure and trade?
In what ways can real numbers be ordered on a number line?
core_competencies: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving
